page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, with 1.0 thread per core. The memory configuration consists of 16.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge delivers modest compute performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores are categorized as poor and weak, respectively. However, the server demonstrates average performance in large-block memory bandwidth tests for both read and write operations, as well as in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents a compute-oriented hardware profile, though its older Intel Xeon processor limits its execution speed in modern workloads. It exhibits weak performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving. It is qualitatively positioned as a budget-friendly option for legacy workloads, light batch processing, or basic utility services that require dedicated CPU cores but do not demand high-throughput memory or advanced instruction sets.
